recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It directly applies the published Security decision while preserving the later example binding semantics and current AuditEvent subtype model.
issue_request: FHIR-22990 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by the Security work group and asked to add http://build.fhir.org/valueset-bundle-type.html, whose canonical is http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bundle-type, to the value set for AuditEvent.subtype.
initial_application: No prior source commit mentioning FHIR-22990 was found in the relevant AuditEvent, Bundle, or fhir.ini history. R5 source and the current source both lacked the bundle-type import in the AuditEvent subtype value set.
additional_context: FHIR-32441 later changed the AuditEvent subtype binding to example and caused the current target to be the audit-event-sub-type-example value set. FHIR-44746 later restored the current AuditEvent.subtype element name after the R5 category/code model. FHIR-26938 documents nearby AuditEvent search subtype guidance using REST interaction codes and does not conflict with adding bundle types.
reconciliation: Updated source/auditevent/valueset-audit-event-sub-type-example.xml to include http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bundle-type in its compose. AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini and AuditEvent.subtype binds to this value set, so the edit is in current build scope.
source_changes: source/auditevent/valueset-audit-event-sub-type-example.xml: added an include for http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bundle-type to the ValueSet.compose.

related_jiras.note: Changed the AuditEvent subtype binding to example and explains why the current target is an example value set.
Restored the current AuditEvent.subtype element name after the R5 category/code model.
Documents nearby AuditEvent subtype guidance for FHIR searches using REST interaction codes and does not conflict with adding bundle types.
